notes.title: Book Three - The End is here
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5wVBNXQ.jpg[/img]

Our work is done. The cathedral is built. The game is complete! It was a pleasure and an honor for us to be able to work on such an epic project with our great team! We hope you will enjoy it!

Now go and play - and remember: life is a great adventure!

[h1]Book Three - [u]the final book[/u] - is out now.[/h1] 

Check out our new trailer: https://youtu.be/T8PL4dBokwE

notes.title: Book Three - The End is near... very near!
notes.content:
Will Aliena and Jack be reunited? Will Kingsbridge be restored to its former glory? Will Shiring be freed from the tyranny of William Hamleigh? And will Philip survive Bishops Waleran’s final attempt to wipe him and his friends off the face of the earth?

Play the epic conclusion of "Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth"! A story that will keep you on the edge of your seat until the very last chapter.

[h1]Book Three - [u]the final book[/u] - will be availabe March 29th 2018![/h1]

Check out our new trailer: https://youtu.be/T8PL4dBokwE

notes.title: Book 2 and 3 Release Schedule
notes.content:
Hi [i]The Pillars of the Earth[/i] fans,

your feedback has been astonishing. We would like to thank you for your support!

We promised to update you on the release schedule of Book 2 and 3 during Gamescom. So here it comes.

[h1]Release Schedule for Ken Follett's The Pillars of the Earth:[/h1]
[b]Book 1:[/b] From the Ashes (available NOW)
[b]Book 2:[/b] Sowing the Wind (available December 2017)
[b]Book 3:[/b] Eye on the Storm (available Q1 2018)

Please remember: by purchasing the game Book 2 and 3 will be automatically added to your Steam library [b]at no further cost[/b] on the date of their respective release.

Thank you
Uyu
